note: Identical configuration in every row. A1's quiet window takes one of two values - about 12 codes or about 46 - chosen per run and held for the run. A0 carries the same signal throughout (p50 1878-1920), so it is not the source amplitude moving. This supersedes issue43-quiet-window-windows.jsonl, which sampled the high mode once and reported it as the bench's noise floor.
